description: "The Poems of Richard Corbet, late bishop of Oxford and of Norwich" by Richard Corbet is a collection of poetry that was compiled and published in the early 19th century. This volume includes a variety of works by Corbet, an accomplished poet and cleric of the 17th century, highlighting his witty and humorous style reflective of the sociopolitical issues of his time.
